description: A policy update that grants nothing the old policy did not grant does not introduce least-privilege issues, whatever its statement ids.

cases.name: narrowing a policy under a new Sid is not a new least-privilege issue (source case: forms-deploy 951687f6b, s3:* on arn:aws:s3:::* narrowed to s3:PutObject on objects)
narrowing with a condition under new Sids is not a new issue (source case: terraform-aws-eks 60dcc4506)
guard: a new action outside the old grants is a new issue
guard: dropping a condition widens the policy, so its issues are new
guard: removing a Deny widens the policy, so its issues are new
